svg.title: Box 2 wiring (statue 2)
svg.desc: Three RJ45 jacks, seven MAX485 receivers with idle bias, and seven tower data outputs in box 2. Generated by tools/wiring_diagrams.py; do not edit.
svg.text: 7 receivers, one per tower. Jack N here = jack N at the controller
Legend · lines that cross without a dot are not connected
perfboard 5 V rail (fed from the PSU, see power diagram)
perfboard GND rail (same wire everywhere it appears)
RJ45 pigtail wires, T568B colours (striped = white/colour)
to supply box A at T2 · + GND
to supply box A at T2 · + GND
to supply box B at T3 · + GND
T4 splitter, in this box · + GND
to supply box D at T5 · + GND
to supply box E at T6 · + GND
to supply box E at T6 · + GND
Each receiver: 560 Ω A→GND and B→+5V hold the line idle-low when the controller is off, so the towers stay dark instead of flickering.
